question: How is the eternal you composed of the Hamsa great mantra and situated in the mandala middle?
premises: The eternal you is made of the Hamsa great mantra
It expects auspicious and inauspicious karma
It is situated in the mandala middle as Shakti great bridge
inference: The Hamsa mantra forms the eternal identity placed in the mandala, serving as the great bridge of Shakti.
uncertainties: śubhāśubhāpekṣī may mean awaiting good and bad or observing them
mahāsetu may be a compound title rather than a literal bridge
plain_english: You are eternal, composed of the Hamsa great mantra, expecting auspicious and inauspicious, situated in the middle of the mandala, the great meaning and cause of the great bridge of Shakti.
